text:
Oliver: FYI, Huntwell legal just put the POC on hold — says marketplace contract + data residency SLA required before pilot can accept payment. Need an exec nudge. :grimacing:
Maria: Ugh. They want a marketplace purchase order flow (procurement) instead of normal SOW billing?
Ajay: Correct — procurement insists on our marketplace terms so they can do their central billing. Pricing OK, but they won't sign without contract in vendor portal.
Tess: I can review the marketplace contract. Any specific redlines they're asking for?
Oliver: CISO flagged two items: 1) data residency EU-only; 2) customer-managed KMS requirement for logs. They said marketplace flow must include those controls.
Vikas: EU-only is fine for Private deployments. KMS for logs is trickier — we can offer BYO-KMS for model keys, but logs live in our observability stack. Need to confirm audit log export with KMS encryption at rest.
Maria: I've told Huntwell we can do EU-only infra and explore export options. Procurement is also pushing for fixed monthly pilot fee vs usage billing.
Ajay: Finance can do a pilot flat fee but will need CRO signoff for any non-standard billing.
Jen: Tagging CRO (not in channel) — can someone confirm the commercial flexibility? We need a quick call with execs on their side. :phone:
Tess: Uploading proposed redline checklist to the folder. Link: https://internal.redwood/pocs/huntwell/contract-checklist (shared)
Oliver: Thanks Tess. Can someone escalate to VP Sales/Revenue? Asking for a short exec-to-exec call this week.
Ajay: I will ping Raj (VP Sales) now.
Vikas: For engineering note — if they require BYO-KMS for logs, we'll need a 2-3 week change window and a security review. Flagging as potential timeline risk.
Maria: Also ask Customer Success to confirm POC acceptance criteria — we may need to scope a reduced feature set to make timelines.
Oliver: Action items: Ajay → escalate to Raj; Tess → initial redlines in folder; Vikas → feasibility note + ETA; Maria → confirm acceptance criteria with Huntwell. If Raj OKs commercial, we can unblock procurement.
deploy-bot: New file added to shared folder by Tess: contract-redline-checklist.pdf :page_facing_up:
Ajay: Raj replied — "I'll join the exec call. Please send a 30-min agenda + proposed times."
Oliver: Sending proposed times now. Please add any other risks.
Maria: Adding note: Marketplace onboarding typically takes 48-72h once legal signs. So if we can get contract signed this week, POC could start next week.
Oliver: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will update thread after exec sync. :thumbsup:
